verdict.description: Aggregate derived from the two dimensions: fail if one dimension fails, pass only when both pass.

function_verdict.description: The qa-gui Function dimension, kept separate and never overwritten by the aggregate. Required for a graded verdict in a target-locked run.

ui_visual_verdict.description: The qa-gui UI+Visual dimension, kept separate and never overwritten by the aggregate. Required for a graded verdict in a target-locked run.

attempt_id.description: Unique ID of the attempt. Old records may lack it; Team QA then derives case_id#attempt if it is not a duplicate.

attempt.description: Which attempt of the case in the run, counted from 1. Without this axis, a case that failed three times and passed on the fourth looks exactly like a case that passed at once.

parent_attempt_id.description: attempt_id of the attempt right before. An old record without attempt_id uses the derived ID case_id#attempt; the first attempt has no parent.

started_at.description: Start timestamp of the attempt, ISO 8601. Without it, the duration cannot be measured and slow cannot be told apart from hung.

ended_at.description: End timestamp of the attempt, ISO 8601, not earlier than started_at.

timeout_ms.description: Time limit of that very attempt, in ms. A duration that reaches the limit means the attempt was cut off midway, so it cannot get a graded verdict.

failure_class.description: Source of the failure: product means the product is wrong, harness means the test runner is wrong, environment means the infrastructure is wrong. Absent on a fail means not yet investigated, so that failure counts toward product; never guess the other way.
